rule: Two-word sign grammar: each tavern, equipment shop and temple name is prefix plus suffix from fixed lists, with the coastal city using a separate suffix list. A city keeps a per-city seen-set and redraws until the pair is new. Equipment names substitute a city-type token and a seeded first-name token. NPC names come from a rule table per race and gender (pick from chunk list, fixed string, or chance-gated pick). Rulers take the first word of a seeded name. Rumour and dialogue lines are template strings with %-tokens resolved from the live world (nearest building of a type, ruler, direction). Defects noted in the file: chance test off by one, template lookup returns neighbour key silently, substitution rescans inserted text, wild path skips dedupe and coastal list, unbounded redraw loop, centre-province oath uses global RNG, debug fallback strings shown to player.
keep: two-word sign grammar with separate coastal suffix list
per-city no-repeat set for sign names
seeded first-name token inside an equipment sign
NPC name rule table: pick, fixed string, chance-gated pick
ruler name seeded by the city, first word only in dialogue
rumour line that resolves to the nearest real building of a type
one template token list resolved against live world state
change: every word list (ours, not donor text)
chance test to strictly less than
template lookup must match the key, not the next key
advance the substitution scan by the replacement length
wild path gets the same dedupe and coastal flag as city
cap redraw loops and fall back to a duplicate
seed the centre-province oath from the world seed, not the global RNG
replace '<no nearby ...>' debug text with a diegetic fallback line
server picks the rumour text id from a seeded roll (zone id, NPC id); client only shows it
look_test: Phone 375 wide: a zone card with three lines: a two-word tavern sign, a rumour sentence from the seeded pick, and a where-is line that names a real nearby entrance. Compare: revisit the zone (same sign and rumour), toggle the coastal flag (second word changes), ask the same citizen twice (same line). Build as a flag on the existing zone card, publish to /preview/, no release rows.
